description: This file defines the `AttendanceConfigurationModel` class in the OrangeHRM project, used within the Attendance API. It acts as a data model that serializes `AttendanceConfiguration` objects into an array, likely for API responses.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class implementing `Normalizable` to serialize attendance configuration data for API responses. It encapsulates an `AttendanceConfiguration` object and exposes its properties as an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an `AttendanceConfiguration` object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the attendance configuration into an associative array with specific permission flags.
